<page>
Mendez & Graham LLP
Houston, TX
Phone 713-555-6582
Letter of Representation
05/25/2024
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1072
Our client: Colleen Black
Date of loss: 04/22/2024
Dear Claims Representative:
This firm represents the individual injured in the rear-end collision described in the enclosed file, and we ask that all further
communication regarding this matter be directed to our office rather than to our client. Please do not contact the client directly
about the claim, the accident, or any settlement discussions.
Our client sustained injuries in the collision and is currently receiving medical treatment. We are gathering records and will
provide documentation of medical expenses, lost income, and other damages as they are compiled.
To permit a proper evaluation of this claim, please disclose in writing the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to
the at-fault driver, including any applicable excess or umbrella coverage known to you.
We further request that the insurer preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes photographs, vehicle data and event
data recorder information, dashcam or telematics records, recorded statements, adjuster notes, claim file materials, and any repair
or total-loss appraisal documentation. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal of such maetrials while the claim is
pending.
We look forward to your prompt written acknowledgment of this letter.
Sincerely,
Stephanie Thomas
Mendez & Graham LLP
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
